hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: Bengaluru's Century-Old Culinary Icon
hero.subtitle: Savor the timeless taste of our legendary Benne Dose and authentic South Indian delicacies, an emotion that holds Old Bengaluru together.

about.title: The Enduring Heart of Old Bengaluru
about.paragraph1: Established in 1920, **Central Tiffin Room**, also affectionately known as CTR, is more than just an eatery—it's a legendary institution woven into the very fabric of Old Bengaluru's history. For over a century, we've delighted generations with our iconic Dosas, fluffy Idlis, and a cherished array of South Indian delicacies, each a testament to timeless taste and culinary mastery.
about.paragraph2: Our rich legacy, nurtured by the visionary Subramanyam brothers and now carried forward by the 3rd Generation baton carriers Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari, epitomizes a commitment to tradition. At **Central Tiffin Room**, we pride ourselves on delivering "Bengaluru’s Best Benne Dose," maintaining the original taste and vintage charm that has earned us the boundless love and unwavering support of our patrons for over 100 years. We are truly the emotion that holds Old Bengaluru together.
